_comment: Bible section 10. Tier 1 starters are gender-restricted; tiers run 1..7. Promotion requires level, stats, mastery, items and quests. Warrior and Mage lines are built out through tier 7 as the reference implementation; new lines are added here, never in Python.

classes.name: Squire
classes.description: A young man trained to the blade, still learning what it costs.

classes.name: Maiden
classes.description: A young woman with a quick blade and quicker feet.

classes.name: Acolyte
classes.description: A student of the arcane, dangerous well before they are wise.

classes.name: Knight
classes.description: Sworn, armoured, and immovable.

classes.name: Duelist
classes.description: One blade, one opening, one answer.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: The arcane, understood well enough to be aimed.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A blade held in service of something larger.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: The fight ends before most people know it started.

classes.name: Archmage
classes.description: Magic no longer answers a request. It answers a command.

classes.name: Templar
classes.description: The oath made flesh, armour and judgment.

classes.name: Nightblade
classes.description: Half shadow now, and the half that remains is sharp.

classes.name: Archon
classes.description: A mind wide enough to hold a storm.

classes.name: Crusader
classes.description: A one-person siege.

classes.name: Shadowlord
classes.description: The dark does not hide them. It obeys them.

classes.name: Sorcerer King
classes.description: Reality has learned to be polite.

classes.name: Godsworn
classes.description: Something answered the oath. It has not left since.

classes.name: Eclipse
classes.description: Where they pass, the light simply declines to follow.

classes.name: Worldweaver
classes.description: They do not cast spells. They revise the terrain.

classes.name: Ascendant
classes.description: The end of the climb, and the beginning of the view.

classes.name: Berserker
classes.description: Fury made flesh, trading defence for devastating offense.

classes.name: Warlord
classes.description: A battlefield commander who strengthens allies and breaks enemy morale.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A master of the bow and wilderness survival.

classes.name: Shadow Dancer
classes.description: A silent killer who moves between shadows and strikes without warning.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A divine healer and protector, channeling holy power to mend and shield.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: A wielder of forbidden arts, trading soul for power over shadow and flame.

classes.name: Dark Knight
classes.description: A warrior who channels shadow into steel, trading holy light for devastating dark power.

classes.name: Sentinel
classes.description: An immovable guardian whose shield becomes a wall between allies and death.

classes.name: Blademaster
classes.description: A warrior whose blade moves faster than thought, striking a dozen times before the enemy falls.

classes.name: Trickster
classes.description: A cunning fighter who wins through misdirection, evasion, and perfectly-timed debuffs.

classes.name: Chronomancer
classes.description: A mage who bends time itself, accelerating allies and freezing foes in temporal loops.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.description: A master of death magic who drains life from foes and commands the undead.

classes.name: Berserker Champion
classes.description: A warrior whose rage knows no bounds, dealing devastating damage at the cost of all defence.

classes.name: Bloodrager
classes.description: A warrior who feeds on the life force of enemies, healing through carnage.

classes.name: Warchief
classes.description: A berserker who leads through strength, inspiring allies with devastating war cries.

classes.name: High Commander
classes.description: A battlefield general whose presence alone strengthens every ally within sight.

classes.name: Tactician
classes.description: A master strategist who reads the battlefield like a chess board and counters every move.

classes.name: Banneret
classes.description: A mounted warrior whose banner inspires charges and whose lance breaks formations.

classes.name: Pathfinder
classes.description: A wilderness master who reads the land like a book and never loses their way.

classes.name: Beastmaster
classes.description: A ranger who bonds with wild creatures, fighting alongside loyal animal companions.

classes.name: Marksman
classes.description: A precision shooter whose arrows find the smallest gap in any armour.

classes.name: Phantom
classes.description: A ghost-like assassin who moves unseen and strikes from impossible angles.

classes.name: Nightstalker
classes.description: A shadow-mage who blends dark magic with blade work, striking from the void itself.

classes.name: Saboteur
classes.description: A master of traps, poisons, and sabotage who weakens enemies before the killing blow.

classes.name: High Priest
classes.description: A divine conduit whose healing power can pull allies back from the brink of death.

classes.name: Inquisitor
classes.description: A holy warrior who burns away corruption with righteous fire and purifying steel.

classes.name: Oracle
classes.description: A seer who glimpses the threads of fate, bending time and fortune to protect allies.

classes.name: Dread Lord
classes.description: A master of forbidden arts whose dark power corrupts everything it touches.

classes.name: Hexblade
classes.description: A warrior-mage who channels dark magic through their weapon, striking with cursed steel.

classes.name: Soulbinder
classes.description: A warlock who binds enemy souls, draining their essence and turning it against them.

classes.name: Shadow Reaver
classes.description: A warrior consumed by shadow, wielding darkness as both weapon and armour.

classes.name: Iron Bastion
classes.description: An unbreakable wall of steel and will, the last line of defence.

classes.name: Stormblade
classes.description: A whirlwind of steel whose strikes fall like lightning.

classes.name: Illusionist
classes.description: A master of misdirection who fights with shadows and deceit.

classes.name: Time Weaver
classes.description: A mage who bends the fabric of time itself, accelerating allies and freezing foes.

classes.name: Lich Lord
classes.description: A master of death who has transcended mortality, draining life from all who oppose.

classes.name: Bloodlord
classes.description: A warrior whose rage is matched only by the devastation they leave behind.

classes.name: Blood Sovereign
classes.description: A warrior who feasts on the life force of enemies, growing stronger with every kill.

classes.name: Horde Lord
classes.description: A war leader whose battle cries inspire armies and shatter enemy morale.

classes.name: Supreme Commander
classes.description: A general whose presence alone turns the tide of battle.

classes.name: Grand Strategist
classes.description: A master of warfare who reads the battlefield like a chess grandmaster.

classes.name: Cavalry Lord
classes.description: A mounted champion whose charge breaks formations and inspires charges.

classes.name: Trail Warden
classes.description: A master of the wilderness who can track any prey and survive any terrain.

classes.name: Alpha Predator
classes.description: A ranger who fights alongside a pack of loyal beasts, the alpha of all predators.

classes.name: Deadeye
classes.description: A sniper whose arrows never miss and whose shots always find the kill zone.

classes.name: Wraith Lord
classes.description: A ghost-like assassin who exists between worlds, striking from the void.

classes.name: Void Walker
classes.description: A shadow-mage who steps through the void itself, appearing behind enemies.

classes.name: Demolitionist
classes.description: A master of traps and sabotage who destroys enemies before they know they're in danger.

classes.name: Divine Oracle
classes.description: A conduit of divine power whose healing can pull allies back from death itself.

classes.name: Purifier
classes.description: A holy warrior who burns away corruption with righteous fire and purifying steel.

classes.name: Fate Weaver
classes.description: A seer who glimpses the threads of fate, bending time and fortune to protect allies.

classes.name: Archfiend
classes.description: A master of forbidden arts whose dark power corrupts everything it touches.

classes.name: Doom Blade
classes.description: A warrior-mage whose cursed weapon drinks the souls of those it strikes.

classes.name: Soul Reaper
classes.description: A warlock who harvests souls, growing stronger with each life claimed.
